{
  "idea": "Factor the defining quadratic to show that S contains exactly −14 and 8. Then evaluate the sum over those two elements.",
  "proof": "  have hS : S = ({(-14 : ℝ), 8} : Finset ℝ) := by
    ext x
    simp only [Finset.mem_insert, Finset.mem_singleton]
    constructor
    · intro hx
      have hq := (h₀ x).1 hx
      have hf : (x - 8) * (x + 14) = 0 := by
        nlinarith [hq]
      rcases mul_eq_zero.mp hf with h | h
      · right
        linarith
      · left
        linarith
    · rintro (rfl | rfl)
      · apply (h₀ _).2
        norm_num
      · apply (h₀ _).2
        norm_num
  rw [hS]
  norm_num [Finset.sum_insert, Finset.sum_singleton]",
  "insight_statement": "S = ({(-14 : ℝ), 8} : Finset ℝ)",
  "insight_proof": "  ext x
  simp only [Finset.mem_insert, Finset.mem_singleton]
  constructor
  · intro hx
    have hq := (h₀ x).1 hx
    have hf : (x - 8) * (x + 14) = 0 := by
      nlinarith [hq]
    rcases mul_eq_zero.mp hf with h | h
    · right
      linarith
    · left
      linarith
  · rintro (rfl | rfl)
    · apply (h₀ _).2
      norm_num
    · apply (h₀ _).2
      norm_num"
}
